text: 工业和信息化部发布关于开展专精特新赋能中心建设工作的通知，“十五五”期间，在全国范围内按照“先试点、后推广”的模式，建设一批专精特新赋能中心，形成覆盖重点领域、辐射全国的专精特新赋能网络，补齐中小企业高能级技术创新服务短板，提高创新资源要素保障水平，加速提升中小企业创新能力、核心竞争力和产业链配套能力，推动中小企业专精特新发展质量明显提升、专精特新“小巨人”企业持续涌现，为发展新质生产力、壮大先进制造业、构建现代化产业体系提供有力支撑。
text_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology issued a notice on carrying out the construction of specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative empowerment centers. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, following the model of "pilot first, then promote," a batch of specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative empowerment centers will be built nationwide to form an empowerment network covering key areas and reaching across the country, shore up shortcomings in high-level technological innovation services for SMEs, improve the guarantee level of innovation resources and factors, accelerate the improvement of SMEs' innovation capabilities, core competitiveness and industrial chain supporting capabilities, and promote a marked improvement in the development quality of specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative SMEs and the continued emergence of specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative "little giant" enterprises, providing strong support for developing new quality productive forces, strengthening advanced manufacturing and building a modern industrial system.
